description: Every infinite binary sequence determines a cofinal branch of the full binary-word tree, and every cofinal branch arises from exactly one binary sequence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.binaryBranches_spec :
  (∀ (x : ℕ → Bool),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsCofinalBranch (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.fullWordTree Bool)
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.binaryBranches x)) ∧
    ∀ (B : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.fullWordTree Bool).carrier),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsCofinalBranch (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.fullWordTree Bool) B →
        ∃! x, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.binaryBranches x = B
